payout_quote: Open a new checking account at SunWest Credit Union between January 1, 2026 and December 31, 2026, with qualifying direct deposit and receive a $200 bonus deposit to your account.
steps: Apply for a new Worry-Free checking account online between January 1, 2026 and December 31, 2026 using promo code "Grab200" (accounts subject to approval; $25 minimum opening balance; if membership is not already established, a $5 donation to SunWest Foundation plus a $5 membership share deposit are required).

Set up a new qualifying direct deposit of at least $1,000 in regular monthly income (salary, pension, Social Security, etc.) sent via ACH by an outside agency — not by the accountholder — and not previously sent to the credit union.
Receive that direct deposit within 60 calendar days of account opening.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $200 bonus is deposited to the account within 30 days of receipt of the qualifying direct deposit.
catches: Direct deposit must be at least $1,000/month of regular income (salary, pension, Social Security) via ACH from an outside agency — deposits you make yourself, peer-to-peer transfers, and deposits previously sent to SunWest do not qualify.
The qualifying direct deposit must be received within 60 calendar days of account opening.

Maximum of one $200 bonus per member; the checking account has a $25 minimum opening balance, and brand-new members also pay a $5 donation to the SunWest Foundation plus a $5 membership share deposit.
The $200 bonus is reported on tax form 1099-INT (taxable interest income).
Accounts are subject to approval; membership/field-of-membership eligibility applies (Colorado-area credit union).
biggest_catch: The direct deposit bar is high — a full $1,000+/month of outside-ACH income (paycheck, pension, Social Security) must land within 60 days; self-transfers and P2P apps don't count.
eligibility: New Worry-Free checking accounts opened 1/1/2026–12/31/2026 with promo code Grab200. Must be SunWest Credit Union membership-eligible and approved. One bonus per member.
timing: Bonus deposited to the account within 30 days of receipt of the qualifying direct deposit.
